limitations: macOS arm64 only; sandbox-exec is required, so other OSes would record blocked.
TUI checks drive keys through a PTY and read rendered text; layout details and the interactive /model selector (ctrl+l) were not exercised, only /model with an argument.

Host timeouts were not waited out in wall-clock time: the 300000ms default and explicit 5000ms come from the SDK suite with virtual or injected time; CLI runs observed only abort, shutdown and 401 terminals.

Pi built-in provider catalog refreshes made no outbound attempts in these runs. The only observed outbound traffic was the TUI tools manager probing fd/fdfind/rg and trying github.com 6 times to download them; the guard refused and logged every attempt, the TUI still passed, and no non-loopback connection succeeded.
The device fingerprint collector ran ioreg inside the sandbox; its values reached only the loopback mock and are not recorded.
Node 22.19.0 was verified with the publisher checksum only, without GPG signature verification.
No real Devin service, browser or account was used; live behavior remains for task 07.
